speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Numerous questions were filed by Members after the High Court gave its judgment, including questions in relation to the Police investigations and/or the prosecution of the case by the Attorney-General’s Chambers, and what would be done to address the issues that were identified in the High Court’s judgment.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Ms Lim has also filed a motion relating to the justice system and I understand from public statements made by the Workers’ Party that this will also touch on the Parti Liyani matter.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Minister intends that Members should be able to seek clarifications on his Statement.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: There is also the Motion standing in the name of Ms Sylvia Lim.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Given the topic of Ms Lim’s Motion, it is also possible that in the debate on the Motion, Members may refer to matters in the Ministerial Statement.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The speech, discussion and clarifications are likely to go into matters that may also be relevant to existing proceedings.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: In so doing, I wish to sound a cautionary note.
